caveats_4plus.title: Polling race vs partial savepoint write
caveats_4plus.detail: Daemon polls every 30s and applies a 30s 'settle delay' (re-check safetensors size; defer if size changed). PEFT's save_pretrained writes adapter_model.safetensors atomically (write to tmp + rename), so the file should appear at full size in one filesystem op. However, on a slow filesystem or if PEFT changes its save behavior, the daemon could in principle attempt to push a partial file. The size-stable check between two polls (60s apart total: 30s settle + min one poll cycle since dir creation) makes this extremely unlikely. If observed, push_savepoint will fail at the HF SDK level with a checksum/upload error — not a silent corruption.
caveats_4plus.mitigation: size-stable check with SETTLE_DELAY_S=30; HF SDK upload_folder validates file integrity server-side

caveats_4plus.title: HF token expiry mid-train
caveats_4plus.detail: Daemon re-tests token every 5 minutes (or every 60s while invalid). If the token is rotated mid-cycle (e.g. user revokes + regenerates between step-30k and step-35k), the daemon will detect the failure and re-poll. However, if a savepoint push is IN PROGRESS at the moment of token rotation, that single push will fail with HfHubHTTPError and be retried on the next poll cycle.
caveats_4plus.mitigation: TOKEN_RECHECK_INTERVAL_S=60 while invalid; 300s recheck while valid; failed pushes are NOT marked as pushed.txt entries so they will retry on next discovery cycle

caveats_4plus.title: Daemon idle if no new savepoints (training crash)
caveats_4plus.detail: If VLM training (PID 31960) crashes mid-run before reaching step-50k, the daemon's exit-condition kill -0 31960 will return non-zero on the next loop iteration (≤30s) and daemon exits cleanly (logged DAEMON_STOP reason=train_pid_31960_disappeared). However, if PID 31960 is reaped + replaced with a different unrelated process (PID reuse — extremely unlikely on a desktop in <1h), the daemon would continue running until step-50k or manual SIGTERM. Operator should manually verify daemon exit if VLM training is killed/restarted.

caveats_4plus.title: mk2-conform README NOT auto-generated by daemon
caveats_4plus.detail: Trainer (vlm_stage1_train.py) writes a default PEFT boilerplate README.md (~5 KB, generic LoRA template) to each savepoint. The daemon pushes that README AS-IS. The mk2-conform README (5 H2 sections + 4-bullet Caveats per anima_hf_naming_convention_mk2_spec) is NOT auto-generated — it requires Mac-side templating (see state/vlm_stage1_hf_push_2026_05_04/readmes/step-{5k,10k,15k,20k}.md). Recommended follow-up: a Mac-side cycle that retroactively pushes mk2 READMEs for all 6 future ckpts after training completes.
caveats_4plus.mitigation: Boilerplate is acceptable for automated push; mk2 upgrade is a separate cycle (template available at tool/hf_readme_template.md)

caveats_4plus.title: Daemon depends on canonical token at ~/.cache/huggingface/token only
caveats_4plus.detail: Per docs/hf_token_canonical_baseline_2026_05_04.md, the canonical 3-tier order is (1) secret get huggingface.token, (2) ~/.cache/huggingface/token, (3) HF_TOKEN env. Daemon currently consults ONLY tier 2. This is a deliberate simplification: ubu1 has no `secret` CLI mirror of the Mac-side store, so tier 1 is N/A; HF_TOKEN env is not set in the nohup-launched daemon shell, so tier 3 is N/A. If the user lands a fresh token via `secret set huggingface.token` on Mac, they must ALSO sync it to ubu1's ~/.cache/huggingface/token for the daemon to see it.
